key.name: update-interval
key.description: How often the panel values refresh, in milliseconds.

key.name: compact-mode
key.description: Hide the icons and show only values.

key.name: show-cpu
key.description: Display overall CPU load in the top bar.

key.name: show-ram
key.description: Display used physical memory as a percentage.

key.name: show-disk
key.description: Display disk read and write throughput.

key.name: show-gpu-temp
key.description: Display the GPU temperature when a GPU sensor is available.

key.name: show-fan
key.description: Display the highest fan speed when a fan sensor is available.

key.name: cpu-color
key.description: CSS colour used for the CPU metric.

key.name: ram-color
key.description: CSS colour used for the RAM metric.

key.name: disk-color
key.description: CSS colour used for the disk read/write metrics.

key.name: temp-color
key.description: CSS colour used for the CPU temperature when it is below the warning threshold.

key.name: gpu-color
key.description: CSS colour used for the GPU temperature when it is below the warning threshold.

key.name: fan-color
key.description: CSS colour used for the fan speed.

key.name: warning-temp
key.description: Temperature at which the metric switches to the warning colour.

key.name: critical-temp
key.description: Temperature at which the metric switches to the critical colour.
